title: Referrals and Authorizations Across PCM, Plan and Region Changes
content:
What happens to an existing authorization under **Referrals and Authorizations** when the patient's PCM, plan or region changes is governed by the following terms.

1. **PCM change.** An authorization stays valid after the patient changes PCM where the type's setting keeps it valid after a PCM change, and the new PCM does not need to re-request it.
2. **Transfer out of the West Region.** An authorization does not survive an enrollment transfer out of the TRICARE West Region where the type's setting does not keep it valid after a region transfer; the gaining region issues its own.
3. **Plan change inside the region.** A change of plan inside the region (TRICARE Prime to TRICARE Select, or the reverse) keeps the authorization on file, but whether the care still needs it follows the new plan.

## Summary of effects

| Change | The authorization | Who acts |
|---|---|---|
| New PCM, type setting keeps it valid | stays valid | no new request by the new PCM |
| Enrollment transfer out of the West Region, type setting does not keep it valid | does not survive | the gaining region issues its own |
| TRICARE Prime to TRICARE Select, or the reverse | stays on file | whether the care needs it follows the new plan |

## Illustration (hypothetical)

A patient holding a Rehabilitative Therapy Referral moves from TRICARE Prime to TRICARE Select inside the West Region. The referral stays on file; whether the therapy visits still need it is decided by the plan requirement for TRICARE Select.
